event_types_complete_sheet_check.name: event_types_complete_sheet_check

event_types_commented_rejection_check.name: event_types_commented_rejection_check

games_placeholder_check.name: games_placeholder_check
games_placeholder_check.value: ("games"."home_team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "games"."away_team_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "games"."status" = 'scheduled'

games_distinct_teams_check.name: games_distinct_teams_check

games_final_score_check.name: games_final_score_check
games_final_score_check.value: "games"."status" <> 'final' OR ("games"."home_score" IS NOT NULL AND "games"."away_score" IS NOT NULL)

outbox_facts_subject_check.name: outbox_facts_subject_check
outbox_facts_subject_check.value: ("outbox_facts"."backtest_request_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('backtest_request_to_do', 'backtest_request_deadline_changed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."deadline_game_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('backtest_request_deadline_changed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."player_event_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('backtest_request_deadline_changed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."event_type_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('type_proposal_new')) AND ("outbox_facts"."incident_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('incident_opened', 'incident_closed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."lot2_subject_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('alert_sheet_produced', 'alert_sheet_updated', 'tracked_result_ready'))

stats_source_mappings_established_check.name: stats_source_mappings_established_check
stats_source_mappings_established_check.value: ("stats_source_mappings"."status" = 'established') = ("stats_source_mappings"."source_player_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "stats_source_mappings"."established_at" IS NOT NULL)

task_runs_waiting_check.name: task_runs_waiting_check
